finding: Moses distinguishes hand-held pen/pencil or planchette passive writing from claimed direct psychography. He reports a pocket-book, initially slow watched writing, later questions above answers, and subsequent revision. These attributed spiritualist accounts differ from rapid Surrealist composition; they do not establish spirit identity, external authorship or a general trance-induction protocol.
